source: https://mosoo.ai/ (fetched 2026-08-03; the landing is a client-rendered Vite+React SPA, so extraction is from the token CSS, route JS chunks, i18n bundles, and downloaded imagery rather than rendered DOM)
also fetched: /en, /en/pricing, /en/use-cases, /en/status, /blog, /docs/, /docs/quickstart/ plus asset chunks (app, index, landing-below-fold, pricing, unicorn, motion-variants) and /landing imagery
product_context: mosoo — open-source agent runtime/backend: 'Run OpenAI Codex, Claude Agent SDK, and OpenCode behind one Agent API in isolated sandboxes.' Trilingual site (en/zh/ja) with cookie-based locale routing

color.palette_type: nature-vocabulary token system — full 'green' + 'ink' + 'paper' scales plus earth-named semantics (soil/sky/amber/ember); THREE themed surfaces: app (paper white + electric lime), landing (warm cream + forest green via data-theme=landing), dark

app_theme_default.accent: #6fd305 (green-500, electric lime) — hover #5cb300, press #3a6e0e, soft #f4fce4, ring #6fd30573
app_theme_default.primary: #1c2024 (ink-900 — primary actions are ink, accent is the brand green)
app_theme_default.text: fg-1 #1c2024 / fg-2 #656c75 / fg-3 #828a93 / muted #aeb5be (cool blue-gray 'ink' scale)

landing_theme.note: data-theme=landing re-derives EVERY scale warm: greens become forest (#127a46 g500, accent green-700 #086030), inks become moss-tinted (#0b1a14 ink-900), paper becomes cream (#f7f6f1 paper-100, #efede4 paper-200), sky/amber/ember desaturate (#5a8fb8/#d49a3c/#c9523b); primary = accent (green buttons on landing vs ink buttons in app)

dark_theme.note: primary flips to green-600 in dark (green becomes the action color)

earth_semantics.note: semantic tokens are named after nature (soil/sky/amber/ember), not status words — the brand metaphor lives in the token layer itself

color.docs_site: Fumadocs (Next.js) re-skinned via --ms-* bridge tokens: same green/ink scales mapped onto fd-* vars; dark docs are green-tinted near-blacks (#0d0f0c bg, #12160f card, #14180f code bg, #9aa39a olive-gray muted text)
color.contrast_strategy: cool ink-on-paper for the app (near-black #1c2024 on #fbfbfc), warm moss-on-cream for the landing; lime accent reserved for brand moments/CTAs/focus rings; alpha borders on every surface

typography.heading_font: Geist (var --font-display), with Cabinet Grotesk (variable 100–900, self-hosted woff2) layered in via JS as '"Cabinet Grotesk", "Geist", …' for landing display type
typography.mono_font: Geist Mono; docs site uses DM Sans + Hanken Grotesk + JetBrains Mono instead
typography.type_scale_tokens: explicit --fs steps: 12 / 13 / 14 / 15 / 16 / 18 / 20 / 24 / 30 / 36 / 48 / 64px; line-heights tight 1.1 / snug 1.25 / normal 1.45 / loose 1.6
typography.heading_classes: .h-display 64px/800/lh1.1, .h1 36px/800, .h2 24px/700 — heavy weights (700–800) with zero letter-spacing; a chunkier, friendlier headline voice than the tight-tracked dev-tool norm
typography.font_style_notes: 13–15px odd sizes tokenized for UI density; the landing's display personality comes from Cabinet Grotesk's rounded geometry at weight 800

spacing.content_density: app console compact (13–15px UI sizes); landing comfortable
spacing.section_rhythm: landing sections revealed on scroll via use-in-view; consistent token-stepped gaps

layout.grid_system: SPA landing + console app + separate Next.js docs and blog; sidebar-based console (--bg-sidebar token, environment rows)
layout.landing_structure: hero ('Open source · Agent runtime and API' eyebrow, one-liner pitch, Star-on-GitHub + Deploy-to-Cloudflare CTAs, Unicorn Studio WebGL background) → agent console demo (fake agents: 'Clara Barton', 'Contract reviewer', 'Support copilot' across Customer Ops/Contract Desk/Internal Tools) → 'Invoke its agents anywhere' (Skill.md export / typed HTTP API / Slack-Lark-Discord-Telegram-WeChat channels) → runtime comparison (Claude Agent SDK: streaming, native resume, MCP tools, session replay) → Cloudflare self-host pitch (Workers/D1/R2/KV) → FAQ (11 who/why/where/what/which/when/how questions) → pricing link
layout.docs_layout: Fumadocs three-column, re-skinned with ms tokens
layout.blog: 'Notes from the bamboo grove' — letter-style posts with category filter (Engineering/Product), author 'mosoo team'
layout.alignment: standard centered-hero landing; console UI left-aligned

shape.radius_scale: tokenized --r-xs 4 / sm 6 / md 10 / lg 14 / xl 20px — mid-round, softer than square-cornered dev tools but no pills-by-default
shape.border_usage: translucent ink-alpha hairlines at three strengths (0f/1a/29) so one token set works over any surface; shadow-inset token doubles as a 1px inner ring

elevation.shadow_style: 5-step layered soft shadows, all derived from the ink color at low alpha (xs '0 1px 0' hairline lift → xl '0 30px 60px'); landing variant recolors shadows to the moss ink; dark theme deepens to black alphas
elevation.depth_cues: bg-sunken/bg-elevated surface stepping + alpha borders first, shadows for floating UI

iconography.style: stroke icons (Base UI component library appears in bundle); favicon.svg brand mark
iconography.preferred_set: unconfirmed from static payload — verify live

motion.philosophy: quick, springy micro-reveals; scroll-triggered section entries; one signature AI shimmer
motion.keyframes_observed: landing-hero-reveal (240ms fade+14px rise, staggered delays 40/120/200/280ms), environment-row-enter (rows drop in -6px + scale .99), mosoo-thinking-dot (bouncing dots) + mosoo-thinking-sweep (1.8s text shimmer: background-clip:text gradient sweeping 200% — the 'agent is thinking' indicator), pulse
motion.libraries: framer-motion/motion for React (motion + motion-variants chunks) with use-in-view scroll reveals

components.buttons: app: ink-filled primary (#1c2024) + lime accent for brand CTAs; landing: forest-green primary (primary=accent under data-theme=landing); focus rings in translucent accent (#6fd30573)
components.thinking_indicator: signature component: shimmer-swept gradient text (fg-3→fg-1→fg-3 at 40/50/60% stops) + bouncing dots — the AI-working state is a first-class design token
components.console_demo: landing shows the real console: agent cards with model tags (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro), environment rows, 'Total spend' + 'Export CSV' — product-as-imagery
components.cta_pair: 'Star mosoo on GitHub' + 'Deploy to Cloudflare' — OSS-native CTAs instead of 'Sign up'
components.code_blocks: docs: Fumadocs Shiki blocks on green-tinted dark (#14180f) with fd-diff add/remove tokens
components.i18n_switcher: EN / 中 / 日 language menu, cookie + path-prefix routing

design_style.personality: an agent-infrastructure tool that brands itself as a bamboo grove — nature vocabulary in the token names (ink/paper/soil/sky/amber/ember), pixel-art nature photography, a blog called 'Notes from the bamboo grove', and letters 'to builders' instead of press releases; engineering warmth rather than dark-mode menace
design_style.genre: open-source dev-infrastructure landing, organic-tech school — sits opposite the black-and-neon runtime aesthetic; closest kin is the warm-paper school (Langfuse) but with saturated garden greens and pixel art instead of greige restraint
design_style.visual_language: three deliberate voices: console app in cool ink-on-paper with an electric lime accent (#6fd305 — energetic, screen-native), landing re-themed to cream + deep forest green (calmer, editorial), docs on green-tinted dark; pixelated photography bridges tech and nature
design_style.signature_imagery: pixel-art / posterized nature photographs — bamboo-sky.jpg (lush green bamboo against a blue summer sky, visibly pixelated like an upscaled sprite) and invoke-gradient.jpg (a lime gradient decomposed into 8-bit dithered rectangles); nature rendered in machine texture
design_style.composition: hero over a live WebGL scene with staggered 240ms reveals; below the fold, the actual product console is the imagery; FAQ carries a full journalist question set (who/why/where/what/which/when/how)
design_style.copy_voice: engineer-to-engineer and slightly literary: 'The journey begins with an Imagine If.', 'Notes from the bamboo grove', 'An agent's state is not its process'; concrete infra nouns everywhere (Threads, Runs, sandboxes, BYOK, Workers/D1/R2/KV); honest qualifiers ('these are live pages, not mockups'); trilingual en/zh/ja parity
design_style.interaction_feel: springy (overshoot easing token), fast 240ms reveals, scroll-triggered section entries; the AI thinking shimmer is the emotional centerpiece of the product UI

overview.performance_tier: medium-heavy on the landing hero (third-party WebGL via Unicorn Studio, lazy-loaded from jsDelivr with graceful degradation — component renders nothing if the SDK fails), lightweight elsewhere (CSS keyframes + framer-motion)
overview.primary_technology: Unicorn Studio WebGL scene + framer-motion + CSS keyframes
overview.composite_notes: Extraction from static assets: the Unicorn scene's actual visual content (scene project renders at runtime) could not be observed — verify live before cloning the hero. Landing imagery viewed directly (downloaded JPGs).

webgl_hero.details: UnicornBackground React component loads unicornstudio.js v2.2.0 from jsDelivr CDN and mounts a hosted scene by projectId; wrapped with error state so the hero degrades to static styling if WebGL/CDN fails

pixel_art_imagery.details: signature effect: photographic nature imagery pre-processed into pixel-art (posterized bamboo/willow against blue sky; alt text 'Pixel-art bamboo reaching into a bright sky') and an 8-bit block-dithered lime gradient used as og-image/section background — organic subjects, machine rendering

text_shimmer.details: mosoo-thinking: background-clip:text gradient (muted→bright→muted) swept across the label at 1.8s linear infinite, plus staggered bouncing dots — the agent 'thinking' state

scroll_effects.details: use-in-view + framer-motion variants: sections and environment rows animate in on scroll (fade + small translate + scale); staggered hero reveal cascade at 40ms steps

spring_motion.details: dedicated --ease-spring cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) overshoot token for playful micro-interactions

particles.note: none outside whatever the Unicorn scene renders

shaders.note: no custom GLSL; WebGL is outsourced to Unicorn Studio

glassmorphism.note: opaque paper surfaces with alpha borders
